question: ________ is defined as the output per unit of variable input.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Average product**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The average product**, also known as the **output per unit of factor inputs or the average of the total product per unit of input,** is **determined by dividing the Total Product by the inputs (variable factors).**
